coverage.note: 1979-01-03 to 1979-12-19. The volume is not in chronological order: a meeting dated February 27, 1980 sits between the February 14 and March 7, 1979 meetings; findings are sorted by meeting date. 1979 appeal numbers are four digits (for example 8427) or V-prefixed (for example V-8455), not the 1980s 79-xxx pattern. The October 3, 1979 meeting heading prints October 5; the body date, Wednesday, October 3, is used. The May 2, 1979 meeting body is garbled as May 9, 1973; the heading date is used. The June 13, 1979 meeting body prints June 15; the heading date is used. The November 13, 1979 special meeting heading is garbled; the date is taken from the November 7 minutes. OCR is badly degraded in places, notably the April 1, April 25 and July 18 meetings; quotes use clean verbatim substrings where the full sentence is garbled. Conflicts recorded as printed: Appeal 8451 is used for 65 States Street (January 17) and 43 Clifford Terrace (February 14); Appeal 8465 is used for a protest appeal with no address stated (March 14) and for an alteration at 834-14th Street (March 21); 1750 Waller Street is printed as Appeal 8493 on April 1 and as Appeal 8483 on April 25; the April 18 minutes contain both a further-hearing decision printed as 8488 and a withdrawal announcement for Appeal 8498, both concerning 3773 Sacramento Street; Appeal 8511 is used for a variance and for an alteration at 799 Clayton Street; Appeal 8525 is used for Mechanical Amusement Devices at 870 Valencia Street (May 9) and for a penalty at 418 Pennsylvania Avenue (May 23 and June 6); Appeal 8715 is used for two different appeals, 640 Ortega Street and 290 Roosevelt Way, both decided November 28; the March 14 item printed as 8452 names the appellant and architect of Appeal 8442; stipulation (1) for Appeal 8547 as printed says both that the third floor is residential and that the second and third floors remain commercial; the vote in Appeals 8608, 8609 and 8610 is printed as '? to 1' and is read as 3-1, with four commissioners present and one voting to overrule; the address 67-73 Brosnan is printed without a street type.
